subject: Marketplace reseller fee-flow amendment - operational & legal next steps
messages:
From: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin, Marissa Cole
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@azuremarketplace.microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - initial redlines

Marcus / Marissa —

Thanks for the call earlier. As discussed, attached is CloudBridge's proposed marketplace/reseller addendum to sit alongside the MSA and Order Form. The key asks from our side are:

- Marketplace fee pass-through: a clause that allows CloudBridge to bill customers for marketplace platform fees (listing/pass-through charges) as an additional line item on customer invoices when the purchase originates on a third-party marketplace.
- Liability carveouts and warranty parity: short paragraph to confirm marketplace sales carry the same limited warranty as direct sales.
- Invoicing & timing: CloudBridge requests a 45-day window for pass-through invoice adjustments and a monthly reconciliation statement.

We've highlighted the operative language in the PDF (CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v1_redlines.pdf) and included a fee matrix showing expected fee tiers (Marketplace_Fee_Matrix_v2.xlsx).

Please confirm whether Redwood can accept the pass-through mechanics as drafted or whether you prefer a netting approach (Redwood invoices customer; Redwood remits marketplace fee to CloudBridge). We understand this has implications for revenue recognition and accounting.

We'll also loop in our counsel (Dawn Lee, cc'd) for any legal language refinement. If you want a quick sync with Marketplace Ops, their mailbox is cc'd above.

Best,
Aditi
Head of Strategic Partnerships
CloudBridge Inc.

Attachments: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v1_redlines.pdf (pdf), Marketplace_Fee_Matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@cloudbridge.com>, Marissa Cole
Cc: Karthik Iyer, Vanessa Ortiz
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - initial redlines

Aditi — thanks for sending. Quick read-through below and next steps: 

1) Commercial preference: Redwood prefers the netting flow (Redwood invoices end customer; Redwood pays CloudBridge the net after marketplace fees) for bookkeeping simplicity. That said, we can accept a pass-through line item if CloudBridge can guarantee invoice-level detail and a reconciliation feed.

2) Invoicing window: 45 days is on the long side. Can we agree to 30 days for adjustments and a monthly reconciliation export (CSV) to automate matching?

3) Wording: the current indemnity/fees language needs clearer limits — looping in legal (external counsel) is fine but I'd like Karthik and Vanessa to confirm operational feasibility for listing metadata and billing mapping.

Next steps: Karthik, can you confirm whether Partner Ops can provide the reconciliation CSV and whether we can map marketplace fee SKU codes into our billing system? Vanessa, can you confirm marketplace listing and billing flow constraints with Azure Marketplace? I'll draft a short commercial side counter with the netting option for Marissa to take to CloudBridge if needed.

Marcus
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachment: Marcus_comments_feeflow.docx (high-level commercial counter)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@cloudbridge.com>, Marcus Lin
Cc: Karthik Iyer
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 13:07:00 -0000
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - initial redlines

Aditi — appreciate the transparency. Two commercial notes from Sales: 

- If CloudBridge insists on pass-through line items, we need guaranteed invoice-level metadata (customer purchase id, marketplace transaction id, fee amount, and currency) to support refunds and chargeback flows. Without it, our CS & finance teams will see mismatches.

- Alternative proposal: Redwood issues the invoice to the customer and includes marketplace fees in a separate 'Marketplace Fees' surcharge line that is remitted to CloudBridge in the next payout cycle. This keeps customer-facing billing simpler and avoids customers receiving two separate invoices for a single purchase.

If you prefer pass-through for regulatory reasons, can Dawn confirm there are no contractual prohibitions on Redwood doing the remittance (i.e., is CloudBridge comfortable with Redwood handling the pass-through on their behalf)?

Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Quick reply options: 1) We accept netting (preferred), 2) We accept pass-through with 30-day reconciliation + metadata agreement.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin, Marissa Cole, Aditi Rao
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:35:00 -0000
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - initial redlines

Looping in some operational details from my side: 

- Reconciliation CSV: Partner Ops can provide a monthly reconciliation CSV with the fields you requested (purchase_id, marketplace_txn_id, fee_amount, currency, customer_id). We will need CloudBridge to adopt our mapping table for SKU/fee codes.

- Timing: 30-day adjustment window works for Redwood's billing cadence. If CloudBridge needs 45 days, we can consider a 45/60 compromise for quarter-end closes but prefer 30 for standard months.

- Listing/metadata: Vanessa — do you see any blocker for the marketplace metadata (tax codes and SKU mapping) on Azure?

Karthik
Head of Channel Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin, Karthik Iyer, Marissa Cole, Aditi Rao
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@azuremarketplace.microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - initial redlines

Aditi / team — operational update from Marketplace side: 

- Azure Marketplace supports a supplemental fee line item on customer invoices, but the marketplace only exposes a limited set of metadata fields (purchase id, listing id, gross_amount, fee_amount). We cannot guarantee a marketplace_txn_id that matches CloudBridge's internal txn id unless CloudBridge maps it on their side during ingestion.

- Marketplace Ops confirmed they can provide a monthly report feed. The report is CSV-only and will require CloudBridge to align on column names.

- For the netting flow: Azure requires the listing partner to accept payout remittance instructions. If Redwood is to remit fees to CloudBridge, CloudBridge needs to provide payout account details and confirm any tax reporting obligations.

Operational asks: 1) CloudBridge to confirm the exact fields they require in the feed, 2) provide ACH/payout info if netting chosen, 3) confirm acceptable invoice adjustment window (30 vs 45 days).

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachment: Marketplace_Ops_report_spec.csv (stub)

From: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin, Vanessa Ortiz, Marissa Cole
Cc: Dawn Lee <dawn.lee@brookfield-legal.com>, Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@azuremarketplace.microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 18:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: CloudBridge marketplace addendum - initial redlines

Marcus / Vanessa / Marissa — thanks for the clear options and the operational detail. Agreed next steps: 

1) We will accept the netting flow conditional on: a) Redwood committing to providing a monthly reconciliation CSV with the agreed fields, and b) CloudBridge receiving remittance within the next payout cycle after reconciliation.

2) We confirm 30-day adjustment window (we can agree to a 45-day quarterly exception if needed, documented in the addendum).

3) I'll have Dawn (cc'd) tidy the legal language to reflect netting vs pass-through options and produce a short two-paragraph replacement for the current Section 4 (Marketplace Fees). Expect an updated PDF by Wed EOD.

4) DocuSign: we'll prepare the addendum for signature once wording is finalized — I'll push the DocuSign packet to the link above and notify when ready.

Thanks all — this is moving in the right direction.

Aditi
Head of Strategic Partnerships
CloudBridge Inc.

Attachments: (none). DocuSign packet to follow: https://www.docusign.com/packet/CLDBR-ADDENDUM-2027
